rules.title: OTP or credential request
rules.explanation: The message asks for an authentication secret.
rules.why_suspicious: Legitimate support should not ask you to disclose a one-time code.

rules.title: UPI PIN or payment request
rules.explanation: The message mentions a payment PIN or asks you to claim funds.
rules.why_suspicious: A UPI PIN authorizes a payment; it is not needed to receive money.

rules.title: Urgency or account threat
rules.explanation: The message pressures you with a deadline or account consequence.

rules.title: KYC or identity verification
rules.explanation: The message requests identity or account verification.
rules.why_suspicious: Unexpected verification links can collect personal information.

rules.title: Prize or lottery claim
rules.explanation: The message claims an unexpected prize.
rules.why_suspicious: Prize scams often demand fees or personal details to release winnings.

rules.title: Money transfer pressure
rules.explanation: The message requests a payment or transfer.
rules.why_suspicious: Unexpected payment requests should be verified through a separate trusted channel.

rules.title: Support or organization impersonation
rules.explanation: The sender claims an official or support role.
rules.why_suspicious: An unverified identity claim is not proof that a sender represents the organization.
